title: Concept: Transitive versions cannot be constrained by the manifest
description: package.json declares a package.json with no `overrides` block, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a package.json with no `overrides` block.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a package.json with no `overrides` block.
